sentences.text: This review covers wellbore 15/9-F-9 A in the Volve field, a sidetrack-type well in the 15/9-F cluster drilled from the Volve platform.
No data tools were available when this review was written, so no depths, dates, hole sizes, durations or volumes are stated here.
Any figure needed for the final record should be taken from the verified daily drilling report extract for this wellbore rather than from this narrative.
The wellbore is expected to follow the usual Volve section pattern of a surface hole, an intermediate hole and a reservoir section, each closed by a casing shoe.
Section-by-section hole sizes, measured depths and casing shoe settings must be confirmed against the well's section table before they are reported.
Drilling performance should be judged per section, comparing rate of penetration in each hole section against the field's typical values for the same formation.
Lost time should be split into primary and possible tiers and attributed to activity codes so that the largest contributors are visible.
Real-time curve statistics were not available to this review and are not reported.
Confirm the section depths, hole sizes and casing shoe settings against the verified well data.
Confirm the spud, total depth and completion dates from the report archive before the review is issued.
Reissue this review with quantified claims once the data extraction is available to the checker.
